＋ Add team division

Drawn team divisions are fixed: match format, court and their teams. Names, awards and order can still change. A new team division can be added and drawn with Regenerate Single Division.

COMPETITION STRUCTURE
Grand Champion

The winners of the chosen divisions meet for the Grand Champion award. The match fills in by itself when those divisions finish and joins its court.

＋ Add grand champion match

The tournament is generated: grand champion matches can no longer be added or removed, and their divisions, format and court are fixed. Names and awards can still change.
